reason: D1 rule 2: the jump-to-latest control is a circle, so it overrides the Button primitive's control radius. The only circular button in the app.
Spreads dnd-kit drag attributes and listeners onto the element and needs role='tab'. The Button primitive offers neither.
An absolutely positioned minimap mark. Button's ghost hover would paint a block over the transcript and its active translate fights the mark's own -translate-y-1/2.
role='option' whose highlight follows keyboard state via aria-selected, and which deliberately neutralises hover. On a Button that would mean re-declaring hover on the primitive, which D6 bans.

Full-width list row. The Button primitive is a fixed-height, centred control that owns a radius and a hover fill, and a row is none of those things; it stays a raw element until a Row primitive exists. The full reasoning, including the specificity problem, is recorded under "The Row primitive gap" in docs/web-design-language.md#the-row-primitive-gap.

The inner input and textarea have to stay square inside the group, which draws the one corner the whole control shows. Their own radius would print a second rounded edge a few pixels inside it.
The arrow is a square rotated 45 degrees, so the corner pointing at the trigger is a tip. Any radius would blunt it and leave a gap against the tooltip body.
An inline chip set in a run of markdown prose that renders at several sizes. It must track the text around it, which a fixed step cannot do; 0.9em also offsets the larger x-height of the mono face.

The Button primitive is a fixed-height, centred control that owns a radius and a hover fill, and a row is none of those things; it stays a raw element until a Row primitive exists. Converted from a ghost Button because the primitive's hover:bg-muted outranks bg-row-selected on specificity, so the row vocabulary could never win while it stayed a Button. The full reasoning, including the specificity problem, is recorded under "The Row primitive gap" in docs/web-design-language.md#the-row-primitive-gap.

A tab inside a bar: square, full bar height, lifted to the well colour when active. The Button primitive owns a radius, a fixed height and its own hover fill, none of which a bar tab may have; it shares its classes with the editor tab, which is allow-listed for the same shape.
